Title: General Documents Required for Mauritian Applicants
Description: Applicants are required to upload their: Birth Certificate, Marriage Certificate if applicable, National Identity Card, School Certificate, Higher School Certificate or HSC results, proof of payment of application fees, and a passport-size photo. Applicants holding qualifications other than SC or HSC should also upload the relevant qualifications.

Title: University of Mauritius Eligibility Toolkit
Description: Applicants can use the University of Mauritius Eligibility Toolkit to obtain guidance on programmes for which they may be eligible according to their qualifications and results.

Title: Administrative Fees
Description: The UoM source refers to an administrative fee of Rs10,000 per year under specific conditions related to the Free Tertiary Education Scheme. The complete applicable conditions should be verified from the original UoM source before this information is used by the chatbot.

Title: Payment of Annual / Applicable Fees
Description: The University of Mauritius provides different facilities for the payment of applicable fees. For detailed information on the available payment methods, procedures and instructions, please refer to the official University of Mauritius payment information through the link provided.
